events.quote: Furthemore, S&P Global Ratings assigned a long-term issuer credit rating of BB+ to Finnair Plc with a stable outlook. It is the first credit rating for Finnair.
events.summary: S&P Global Ratings assigned Finnair a long-term issuer credit rating with a stable outlook, the company's first credit rating.
events.title: First credit rating assigned by S&P

events.quote: As a testament to this, Finnair signed a binding secured revolving credit facility of 200 million euros for general corporate purposes and successfully issued a new 500-million-euro unsecured senior bond to refinance the old 400-million-euro unsecured senior bond. The new bond will mature in 2029 and carries a fixed annual interest of 4.750 per cent.
events.summary: Finnair issued a new unsecured senior bond to refinance the old unsecured senior bond, and the new bond matures later with a fixed annual interest.
events.title: New unsecured senior bond issued to refinance

events.quote: Further, in April, Finnair agreed on a new secured revolving credit facility 3 of 200 million euros for general corporate purposes. The arrangement was unused at the end of the year and carries a three-year tenor with a one-year extension option.
events.summary: Finnair agreed a new secured revolving credit facility for general corporate purposes, unused at year-end with a multi-year tenor and an extension option.
events.title: New secured revolving credit facility agreed

events.quote: Industrial action in Finland had an impact on Finnair’s operations, leading to the cancellation of approximately 550 flights in the first quarter and more than 500 flights in the fourth quarter.
events.summary: Industrial action in Finland led to the cancellation of hundreds of flights in the first quarter and again in the fourth quarter.
events.title: Industrial action caused flight cancellations

events.quote: During the financial year, a new A350 aircraft was delivered and additionally, Finnair purchased one leased A350 and one leased A321 aircraft. All aircraft were in operative use as at the balance sheet date.
events.summary: A new A350 aircraft was delivered during the year and Finnair purchased a leased A350 and a leased A321 aircraft.
events.title: New A350 delivered and leased aircraft purchased

events.quote: Thanks to the positive result and our strengthened financial position, we have the opportunity to reward our shareholders after a long time with a return of capital of 0.11 euros per share as proposed by the Board of Directors.
events.summary: The Board of Directors proposed a return of capital per share, rewarding shareholders after a long time.
events.title: Return of capital proposed to shareholders
